COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS
CLCON No. 319 of 2024
Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.
1. Ms. Neeti Rana, learned counse for
the petitioner.
2. I n WPMB No. 33 of 2024, Division
Bench of this Court passed an order on
20.02.2024, to the following effect: -
"8. I n the meantim e, keeping in view that
the certificate (Annexure-6) has been
issued by the Government of I ndia, Ministry
of Statistics & Programme I mplementation,
National Statistical Office, the petitioner is
fully qualified for this contract. He will be
considered for the bid."
3. Thereafter, on 15.07.2024, another
order was passed in the said writ
petition, which is extracted below: -
"3. After hearing counsel for the parties
and going through the counter-affidavit filed,
this Court is of the view that the certificates
attached by the petitioner (Annexure Nos. 6
and 7) relate to the years 2018-2019, 2019-
2020 & 2020-2021, hence as per condition
No. 36, the petitioner fulfils the criteria as all
these three certificates show the experience
of the petitioner which is much more than
fifty per cent of the tender bid.
4. List the m atter on 25.11.2024.
5. No further proceedings will be taken for
allotment of this tender bid till final disposal
of this writ petition."
4. On 07.08.2024, Division Bench
passed the following order in the said
writ petition: -
"5. Keeping in view, the contract was already

2024:UHC:6855
given to him on 24.02.2024, the order dated
15.07.2024, is being modified that allotment
of the contract shall be subject to the final
decision of the writ petition."
5. Petitioner alleges disobedience of
the orders dated 20.02.2024 and
15.07.2024 in this contem pt petition.
6. Mr. Sandeep Tiwari, learned counsel
for the intervener in the writ petition has
produced in Court order dated
07.08.2024 passed in WPMB No. 33 of
2024.
7. From perusal of different orders
passed in WPMB No. 33 of 2024,
especially the order dated 07.08.2024, it
is revealed that the Division Bench was
well aware about the fact that the client
of Mr. Sandeep Tiwari was awarded
contract on 24.02.2024, therefore,
earlier order was m odified and it was
provided vide order dated 07.08.2024
that the allotm ent of contract shall be
subject to final decision of the writ
petition.
8. Since writ petition is pending
consideration before Division Bench,
therefore, this Court is of the considered
opinion that no contem pt is m ade out at
this stage.
9. Accordingly, contempt petition is
dismissed.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J.)
 20.09.2024
